name: draw-diagram
description: The draw-diagram skill as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: draw-diagram
plugins.description: Make editable draw.io diagrams offline: chip and system architecture, algorithm dataflow, state machines and timing laid out by the silicon-canvas engine; flowcharts, sequence, ER and other diagrams from Mermaid, PlantUML or XML. Checks the layout and renders PNG/SVG. Node 20+ only.
